name: English
title: Schnellbild – an image & video viewer for macOS that just doesn't suck
description: Schnellbild: a fast, free image and video viewer for macOS. Folders, thumbnails, the keyboard; MKV, WebM and AVI; ZIP, RAR and 7z as folders; a dual pane to sort photos. No ads, no tracking, no account.
tagline: An image & video viewer for macOS that just doesn't suck.
lead: Open a folder, see thumbnails, look at one picture large, page through with the keyboard. Videos play right there, too, even MKV, AVI and WebM. No library to import into, no waiting, no clutter.
fineprint: macOS 15 or later, Apple silicon. Signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, running in Apple's App Sandbox. Both versions are the same app with every feature; whoever buys it in the Store supports its development.
shotAlt: Schnellbild: folders with previews and photo thumbnails
why: No ads, no tracking, no account
It shows your pictures and talks to nobody.
No pro version, no subscription, no "unlock" button. Every feature is in.
No library to import into, no editor, no cloud. Just looking at photos and videos, done well.
Thumbnails appear while you scroll, big folders and network shares included.
Pictures, videos and archives from others run nothing and go online nowhere, with nothing to switch on first.
Broken files, odd formats and slow disks show a placeholder instead of taking the app down.

features.title: Look at it large, page with the keys
features.text:
Space opens a picture as large as the window allows, ← → page through the folder. Zoom in with the trackpad or + −, turn with ⌥← ⌥→, full screen with f. Animated GIFs, SVG and PDF included.

A slideshow (s) runs through the folder and all its subfolders, photos and videos alike.
features.alt: A photo in the full view

features.title: Videos, also the ones macOS can't play
features.text:
What macOS plays itself (MP4, MOV, AVCHD …) plays through macOS, everything else through the VLC engine built in: MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, DVD video.

  • ← → jump a tenth of the video, ⇧← ⇧→ a hundredth
  • ↑ ↓ set the volume, for every video
  • Finder and Quick Look get thumbnails for MKV, WebM, WMV, FLV and VOB too

features.title: Archives open like folders
features.text: ZIP, RAR and 7z, comics (CBZ, CBR) included, also in several parts; ZIP and RAR also with a password. Nothing is unpacked to disk, and videos play straight from the archive. (7z needs a recent macOS: macOS 15 can't read most of them.)
features.alt: Archives shown as folders with previews

features.title: Sort your holiday photos like in Norton Commander
features.text:
D shows two folders side by side. Mark pictures, then F5 copies and F6 moves them to the other side, or drag them there.

Rename, new folder, trash, bookmarks, and undo for renaming, trashing, copying and moving.
features.alt: Two folders side by side in the dual pane

features.title: Search through every subfolder
features.text: The search field matches the names of folders, archives, pictures and videos, in the folder shown and everything below it. Results arrive while it searches, a slow network share included. Ignoring case, matching it, or a regular expression.
features.alt: Search results from the folder and its subfolders

features.title: Better pictures, files untouched
features.text: E improves exposure, contrast, saturation and sharpness automatically, for photos and videos alike. A opens the sliders. It is a view: your files stay as they are.
features.alt: The adjustment sliders over a photo

features.title: What the file really is
features.text: I shows the format, resolution, codecs, bitrate, bit depth, colour profile and camera, and a note when the file's extension doesn't match its content.
features.alt: The file info next to a photo

features.title: Every key at hand
features.text: F1 lists every key, to print too; K shows a small keyboard to click. Grid or list (L), sort by name, kind, date or size, several windows, and a boss key (X).

safeIntro: Pictures, videos and archives from strangers are exactly what a viewer is for, so Schnellbild treats every file as hostile, out of the box.
safe: No network at all, starts no programs by itself, sees only the folders you open to it plus Pictures, Movies and Downloads.
Looking at something never changes it and never unpacks it to disk.
A "video" that is really a playlist pointing to the internet plays nothing.
Double click opens documents, not programs.
Apps, scripts and installers never, even when they hide behind a picture's name.
safeMore: What it does in detail, and where its limit is: Safe with files from others.
modelsTitle: Coming from Phiewer, IINA or Norton Commander?
modelsText: They were the models: Phiewer for browsing pictures by keyboard, IINA for handling videos quickly, Norton Commander for the dual pane. How Schnellbild compares: a free Phiewer alternative, a free IINA alternative for looking through videos.
ossText: Schnellbild is free software under the MIT License, the source is on GitHub. Found a bug or missing something? Open an issue.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Schnellbild collects no personal data: no account, no analytics, no tracking, no network access.
privacy.intro: Schnellbild is an image and video viewer for macOS. Responsible for it (the controller under the GDPR) is HAUS HOPPE - ITS, Johannes Hoppe; the full address is in the legal notice. This policy covers the app, as downloaded from GitHub and as bought in the Mac App Store (both are the same app), and this website.
privacy.appText:
Schnellbild collects no personal data. It has no account, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking, and it doesn't connect to the internet: the App Sandbox it runs in gives it no network access at all.

What stays on your Mac, and only there:
stays: Settings (the last folder, sort order, bookmarks, volume …) in the app's own preferences.
Folder access: the folders you opened to Schnellbild, as macOS bookmarks, so it can show them again after a restart. Settings → {folderAccess} forgets them.
Archive passwords you typed, in your login keychain (entry "Schnellbild archive passwords"); Settings → {forgetPasswords} removes them.
privacy.appOutro: Schnellbild reads your pictures, videos and archives only to show them to you. It never sends them, their names or anything about them anywhere. Apple handles the download and purchase under its own privacy policy and gives us only figures without your identity: sales, and crash reports and usage statistics if you allowed sharing them with app developers in macOS.
privacy.siteText: This website uses no cookies, no analytics and no content from other servers (no web fonts, no embedded videos). It is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc. (USA). When you visit it, GitHub logs and stores your IP address for security purposes; see GitHub Pages: data collection and the GitHub privacy statement. How long GitHub keeps these logs is up to GitHub; we have no access to them. GitHub takes part in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, for which the European Commission decided that the USA ensures an adequate level of protection (Art. 45 GDPR). The legal basis is our legitimate interest in delivering the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The download of the app comes from GitHub as well.
privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. You have the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to processing based on our legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR). Since neither the app nor this website keeps personal data of its own, there is usually nothing on our side to look up or delete.
privacy.contactText: Questions: open an issue at github.com/JohannesHoppe/schnellbild/issues or use the contact in the legal notice.
